facts.text: Newman is taken to a high mountaintop by the spirit.
The spirit tempts Newman to throw himself down.
The spirit tempts Newman so that Kramer will catch him mid air.
Newman returns to his apartment as though he never left it.
The gang is still there partying when Newman returns.
Newman can fly after returning to his apartment.
